summary: Pre-redeploy QA for MASCI HUB. Both targeted fixes from main agent are CONFIRMED working: (1) Training PDF footer duplication FIXED — across all 12 permutations (field/shop/pm/admin × en/es/bi), every PDF has exactly ONE footer per non-cover page and ZERO on the cover (verified via pypdf text extraction in test_iter29_predeploy.py::TestTrainingPDFFooterField + TestTrainingPDFFooterGated, all 12 parameterized cases PASS). (2) Field Training video auto-seed FIXED — GET /api/training/videos returns {videos: {field-01-hub-navigation: <https url>}} (TestTrainingVideo PASS); on /training/field the lesson-video-error fallback element is visible in the test browser (Chromium lacks H264 — expected per spec note, fallback rendering is the intended behavior, NOT a bug). All 4 logins (admin MASCI1982!, PM Happy123!, shop Nothappy123!, dev Maddix8530!) succeed; wrong passwords return 401. /api/dev/* correctly rejects admin AND PM tokens, accepts dev token. Hub /dev link present (data-testid=hub-dev-link, href=/dev/login). Admin backups run-now+list works. Equipment open-items endpoint accessible by admin AND shop tokens. Legal /legal/terms and /legal/privacy render 200. Mobile horizontal scroll clean on /training, /training/field, /cheatsheet, /legal/terms, /legal/privacy. ZERO console errors on landing pages tested. 25 passed / 7 skipped / 0 failed in pytest run.

ui_bugs.issue: In Chromium test env the H264 video element fails to load and the lesson-video-error fallback (with the exact spec string 'Training video unavailable. Please contact your MASCI administrator.') renders. Per spec/agent_to_agent_context_note this is EXPECTED in the preview test browser (Chromium lacks H264) and the fallback rendering IS the intended fix. Real Chrome/Safari users will see the playable video. Not a bug — fallback works as designed.

issues: Mobile (390x844) shows 13px horizontal overflow: scrollWidth=403 vs clientWidth=390. Other routes (/training, /training/field, /cheatsheet, /legal/terms, /legal/privacy) are clean (sw=cw=390). Likely a single off-margin element on landing — recommend hunting via DevTools 'highlight elements wider than viewport'.

track-card-{field|shop|pm|admin} data-testids NOT found on the 4 training cards (all returned None in DOM scan). The cards render visually with correct content (verified by screenshot), but the testid pattern differs from what was asked. Recommend confirming testid naming on TrainingHub.jsx and update if needed for QA scriptability.

critical_code_review_comments: Training PDF footer fix in /app/backend/training_pdf.py (removed in-body footer_legal repeat from endnote section in single-lang and bilingual paths) is CORRECTLY applied — verified empirically with pypdf across all 12 lang/track permutations. Zero double-footer cases.
Video auto-seed in /app/backend/server.py training_videos_get correctly populates field-01-hub-navigation when collection is empty. Verified live.
/api/dev/* require_dev gate is solid: rejects admin token AND PM token (both 401). Accepts dev token. Strict isolation working as documented.

/app/backend/tests/conftest.py auto-injects X-Admin-Token on every requests.Session call to the backend host. Tests that need to verify unauthenticated behavior must explicitly send headers={'X-Admin-Token': ''} to bypass the patch. Documented inline in test_iter29_predeploy.py for future agents.

Workflow POST schemas (daily-reports, equipment-inspections, inspections, meetings, jhas, incidents) require many fields including project_name, project_number, location, AND endpoint-specific date+time fields (report_date, inspection_date+inspection_time, meeting_date+meeting_time, jha_date, incident_date+incident_time, plus prepared_by, job_title, etc.). Existing /app/backend/tests/test_daily_reports.py, test_equipment_inspections.py, test_inspections.py, test_meetings_jhas.py, test_incidents.py already cover these flows with proper payloads — TestCoreWorkflows in iter29 file is intentionally @skip with a pointer to those files.
Public /api/admin/backups/run-now endpoint takes >10s to respond even when unauthenticated (slow auth check or pre-validation) — consider returning 401 immediately before any work.
